title: WRAM map for the Secret of Mana dual-screen companion (Ancient Cave column filled)
conventions: Addresses are offsets in the 128 KiB WRAM image ($7E:xxxx = xxxx, $7F:xxxx = 0x10000 + xxxx). Verification: verified = changed by a mutation and read back (or an exact observable match); partial = single data point or documentation only; unverified = documented elsewhere but not exercised; not-obtained = no ROM could be run.

vanilla_us.state: route frame 23000 (Potos village, map 131) of tools/fidelity_d_inputs/hhs_glitch_bk2_s9x14.txt + fixture

magno_es.state: same route desyncs; frame 20000 of the route is in map 128 with a controllable hero (HUD not yet enabled) + fixture

ancient_cave.status: boots headless to free play (floor 1) after the name entry; field checks and macro tests run (docs/companion-ancientcave-20261017.md)
ancient_cave.source: Moppu/SecretOfManaRandomizer v1.49 (LGPL-2.1), Windows .NET app that writes a 4 MiB ROM from the user ROM; no IPS/BPS patch exists

static_diff.method: byte compare of the first 2 MiB with regions merged when closer than 16 bytes
static_diff.expansion: second 2 MiB (E0:0000 onward in HiROM addressing) holds new code and data; seed 1 uses 320,088 non-zero bytes up to file offset 0x2532A4
static_diff.header: bytes 0xFFC0..0xFFFF identical to vanilla (title, map mode 0x21, size byte 0x0B, checksum not updated): the header cannot tell the variants apart
static_diff.seed_to_seed: the 45 hook sites are identical for seeds 1 and 777 (same_hook_sites=True); the JSL operands, expansion layout and map data differ

fields.name: hero_status
fields.meaning: Status word. Bit 15 (+0x191 bit 7) = dead/not initialised: such a hero is skipped by the owner cycle and the HUD shows HP 0. Bit 13 (0x2000) = 1 HP per timer drop while +0x1B6 counts down
fields.evidence: Mutation: writing 0x2000 + timer 20 reduced HP 2 per 40 frames and the timer 0x14 -> 0x05; clearing bit 15 made the girl selectable with X
fields.note: other status bits: docs/rom-combat.md section 7, not re-verified
fields.ancient_cave_evidence: word 0x2000 with timer 0x14: HP 50 to 48 in 120 frames, timer now 0x08; word bit 15 on the girl: ring owner cycle [0, 2, 2, 2] skips her

fields.name: hero_status_timers
fields.meaning: Status timers, one byte per status family; +0x1B6 is the one for bit 0x2000
fields.evidence: Poison mutation above (only +0x1B6 exercised)
fields.ancient_cave_evidence: only +0x1B6 exercised: 0x14 -> 0x08 while the status word was set

modes.predicate: NO_GAME if hero0 active != 1; TRANSITION if E6 != 0x0F or E4 != 1; EVENT if D0 != 0; RING if 7D == 1; else FIELD
modes.safe_to_inject: mode == FIELD and a hero is bound to pad 1 ($D9) and that hero is alive

observed.situation: ring open / status page / spell target selection
cast animation after the ring closes
observed.note: no flag marks it; the macro verifies by MP drop within 330 frames

observed.hero0_active: 0 early; 1 with D0 != 0 during name entry in the vanilla route

ring_navigation.open: tap Y (3 frames); $7D becomes 1 within 2 frames, $1812 is non-zero for frames 8..43, ready at about frame 43
ring_navigation.owner: tap X until $1808 == hero; each step re-builds the ring, wait about 80 frames
ring_navigation.category: tap UP until $1809 == wanted (weapon 3, item 0, magic 1); wait about 40 frames per step; at most 4 taps in the cycle weapon, item, magic, config
ring_navigation.cursor: tap LEFT (+1) or RIGHT (-1) along the shorter way; $180A follows after about 9 frames; allow 22 frames per tap

confirm.weapon: 1 x B closes the ring and equips
confirm.item: B selects, a second B (target = bound hero) uses it; ring closes
confirm.magic: B on the spirit opens the 3-entry spell ring; cursor to the spell; B selects it; B on the target; ring closes; MP is paid after about 120..150 more frames

ring_navigation.needs: the unusable cases time out: an item the game rejects (Cup of Wishes on a healthy hero) keeps the target selection open and an attack spell with no enemy in range does not leave the ring; the macro gives up and closes the ring with A/Y taps

hud.vanilla: HUD occupies rows 199..216 of the 256x224 frame (hero boxes with HP numbers, gauge and portraits). Text, frames and the gauge are BG3 (snes9x layer 3); the portraits are sprites in the same rows. Dialogue windows and the ring title window are BG3 too; ring icons are sprites (layer 5). BG1/BG2 are the map, BG4 unused.
hud.hide_strategy: crop rows >= 199 from the video frame (core independent, used by the host). Layer toggles (snes9x_layer_3 / _5 core options) are all-or-nothing per layer and would also hide dialogue windows or every actor.
hud.not_found: OAM index ranges of the HUD sprites, TM/TS shadow registers and a HUD-visible flag were not identified; libretro exposes no OAM/PPU registers

differences: No WRAM field moved: all 34 map fields read the same addresses; no relocated variable was found.
Map id ($DC) is generator numbering: floor 1 outside map = 0, other generated maps 1.., boss maps 256 + 2*floor (from the generator source, not measured); vanilla ids (131 Potos) never appear.

Items: native inventory is one of each, qty 1, in order 0 1 2 3 4 5 7 6; qty-1 records are removed when used and the list shifts up; ids 7 and 6 are titled "Random Music" and "Stuck?" (Stuck? starts a fade and is not consumed).
Weapons: all eight types owned from the start (slot byte 0x00 = owned tier 0); bits 7..6 of the slot byte = holder + 1 (1 boy, 2 girl, 3 sprite).
Party: girl and sprite are active from frame 0, with no spirits until the cave gives them; max HP / max MP are derived by the game from the level.
HUD: drawn on BG3 at rows 184..215 (FLOOR n and a clock row at 184..191, party bars at 199..215) instead of vanilla rows 199..216; the crop at row 199 leaves the floor/clock row visible.
Floor clock: $CF1A counts seconds (+1 every 60 frames); minutes, hours and the floor number were not located.
Name entry rejects duplicate hero names (relevant only to automation of new games).
latent_defects: som_weapon_ring_index ranks owned weapons in type order; the real ring order is types 1..7 then 0 (vanilla too). Stock host: 7 of 64 (held, wanted) equip pairs correct.

The weapon ring cursor is relative to the held weapon: $180A at open holds the held weapon rank, the first directional press re-centres it on 0, and ring position = (cursor + held rank) mod n (vanilla too). Patched host (order + one sync tap + relative target + no-op when already held): 64 of 64.

detection.inputs: ROM size and a few structural facts; never a hash of the whole ROM (two seeds differ in 18,345 bytes of the first 2 MiB)
steps: size 2,097,152 (or +512 header) -> candidate vanilla or translation; 4,194,304 -> candidate Ancient Cave

for a 4 MiB ROM require the vanilla title and header bytes at 0xFFC0 (identical in all variants) plus opcode 0x22 (JSL) at C0:692F and C0:6D1E (file offsets 0x692F, 0x6D1E) with an operand bank >= 0xE0
confirm with the ASCII strings "ancient`cave" and "moppleton" found in the expansion (positions vary by seed: E0:26D3 in seed 777, E0:272B in seed 1)
otherwise vanilla table; if the title matches but a hook site differs (a different randomizer mode), use the unknown-variant table (read-only, no macros)
detection.tables: data/wram_companion_map_ancientcave.json holds per-field AC status; because no address moved, the companion needs one address table and a per-variant behaviour record (item names, map id space, weapon ring rank rule, HUD crop row 184, weapon slot decoding)
detection.runtime_check: independent of the ROM: on a running game compare $E000/$E200/$E400 activity and the ids 0x80..0x82; the map-id space check is not reliable
